description: Header file defining the OpcodeListBuilder class for constructing opcode lists related to DNG image processing, including methods for adding gain maps, warp corrections, and bad pixel lists, as well as associated enums and constants.

classes.name: OpcodeListBuilder
classes.description: Utility class for building opcode lists for DNG processing, supporting addition of gain maps, warp corrections, and bad pixel lists.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the opcode list in bytes.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of opcodes in the list.

methods.name: buildOpList
methods.description: Serializes the opcode list into a provided buffer.

methods.name: addGainMapsForMetadata
methods.description: Adds gain map opcodes based on metadata parameters and lens shading map.

methods.name: addGainMap
methods.description: Adds a gain map opcode with specified parameters.

methods.name: addWarpRectilinearForMetadata
methods.description: Adds warp rectilinear opcode based on metadata.

methods.name: addWarpRectilinear
methods.description: Adds a warp rectilinear opcode with specified coefficients.

methods.name: addBadPixelListForMetadata
methods.description: Adds bad pixel list opcode based on metadata.

methods.name: addBadPixelList
methods.description: Adds a bad pixel list opcode with specified parameters.

methods.name: addOpcodePreamble
methods.description: Adds opcode preamble with specified opcode ID.

methods.name: addBayerGainMapsForMetadata
methods.description: Adds Bayer gain map opcodes based on metadata.

methods.name: addMonochromeGainMapsForMetadata
methods.description: Adds monochrome gain map opcodes based on metadata.
